approach.method_basis: The Parent is a task-local graph genetic algorithm whose evaluation budget is spent by a Gaussian-process Thompson sampler, with one stagnation rule layered on top of it. Every molecule scored in the current session is kept in an archive and the best sixty-four form a breeding population; parents are drawn from high-scoring score quantiles, and each announced batch of ten builds a fresh field of a hundred and sixty de novo offspring by connected-fragment crossover with an optional finishing edit or by a short random walk of atom, bond and ring edits, rejecting anything that is not a single ordinary connected graph, is already known, or widens a fixed neutral sulfur envelope beyond what its own scored parents did. A Gaussian process is then fitted to the accepted scores of this session only, using integer-count radius-two Morgan environment counts with a generalized Tanimoto kernel and the scores recentred and rescaled by their running mean and spread, and one jointly correlated posterior sample per batch position is drawn over the whole field. The ten molecules sent to the oracle are the sequential maxima of those draws: each position takes the largest sampled value among the members still available and the winner is removed before the next position, so a candidate the model rates poorly on average can still win a position when its sampled residual is large. The one thing the Parent adds to that inherited sampler is a stagnation response on the choice set: while its count of consecutive announced batches that failed to raise the session's own best score stands at three or more, only the forty highest-posterior-mean members of the unchanged field are eligible, and the first improving batch restores the full field. The size of the random residual each candidate receives is, in every batch, the model's own predictive standard deviation at that candidate.
approach.novelty: This node changes what the sampled residual's size is a measurement of, and nothing else. Instead of the model's predictive spread - which in this representation is almost exactly a measure of how far a candidate sits from everything the session has already scored - each candidate's dispersion becomes the disagreement among eight refits of the same model on eight bootstrap resamples of the session's own accepted records, and that disagreement is then multiplied by a single number per batch so that the average dispersion over the field is exactly the average the Parent would have used. Only the ordering of the dispersion across candidates changes; its overall size does not. The predictive mean, the correlation pattern between candidates, the one array of random normals and the order in which it is consumed, the sequential winner-removal rule, the stagnation counter and its top-forty eligibility bar, the field, admission, retention and breeding are all inherited untouched. This is the first dispersion on this lineage that is not computed from archive similarity. Siblings on this same Parent corrected the magnitude of the archive-similarity dispersion, priced it in closed form, amplified it explicitly with distance, split the predictor into regimes with their own locations and scales, removed the residual altogether, doubled the field, or changed what could be proposed or admitted - every one of them either kept the archive-distance ordering or threw the dispersion away. Holding the average dispersion fixed by construction is what separates this reading from the magnitude correction that already failed here: if the purchases move, it is because the dispersion now sits on different candidates.

observed_bottleneck: The Parent is the formal Anchor n-61b9b3bfb40d (complete panel 0.607030, population SD 0.030175, +0.010577 paired over its own Parent and inside its own law-free band [-0.055482, +0.014579] measured by n-515ab49db6e0). It spends every oracle call through a correlated Thompson draw whose per-candidate dispersion is the predictive standard deviation of an accepted-only chronological count-Morgan generalized-Tanimoto Gaussian process, and that dispersion is very nearly a monotone function of distance from the session's own accepted archive. Recomputed read-only for this plan from the Anchor's own published pool receipts in all fifteen sessions (the recomputation reproduces its logged pool means to 1.6e-14 and its logged predictive SDs to 9.8e-16, and independently reproduces its 88 restricted batches in 13 of 15 sessions and its 997-of-3,470 out-of-regime rank-40-or-worse share as 908 of the 3,320 non-guard positions plus 89 of the 150 first-batch positions), the per-pool Spearman rank correlation between the dispersion the allocator reads and nearest-neighbour archive distance under the same kernel is mean 0.9401, median 0.9409, range 0.8526 to 0.9962 over 420 fitted pools. In this generator the most archive-distant admitted members are one- to five-atom fragments and duplicated-fragment oversize products rather than alternative scaffolds (h-bd32ed607d0e3a8f, measured on five constructions), so the quantity this allocator prices is degeneracy. Round 46 then closed both ends of the price axis on this same Anchor and left the source of the dispersion untouched: n-707027cd2146 corrected its magnitude exactly as registered and bought worse candidates (out-of-regime picks at posterior-mean rank 40 or worse 997 of 3,470 to 1,572 of 3,520, realized incumbent-increment mass 5.978073 to 5.450779, panel -0.035153); n-698a02f85be1 priced improvement in closed form over the same posterior and lost -0.053288; n-907d480bc1fe calibrated the far field honestly and its archive-far purchases converted at 0.000232 of incumbent mass per evaluation against 0.001752 for agreed picks (panel -0.081702); n-1c27fae8e61d replaced the predictive location and scale with a regime mixture and lost -0.136643; and n-c4c934fd6a68 shows the term is load-bearing, worth -0.126894 with 31.8 per cent of realized increment mass and distinct Murcko scaffolds per session 117.5 to 54.9 when it is removed, landing at the same destination as the mask-free mean-only allocation n-f04cec6ab705. Supply-side and admission remedies on the same Anchor are refuted too (doubled field n-41ba6b01b5a5 -0.030756, motif-level moves n-814ee0b4f000 -0.053376, reserved archive-distance picks n-82195b802723 -0.031639 on the mask-free Parent), and n-cf8d309c06de reproduces the Anchor exactly, so the limiting behaviour is not a scale error, a pricing error or a supply shortage. It is that the only dispersion this lineage has ever handed its allocator is an archive-similarity statistic.

adoptions.applicability: This Anchor already draws one jointly consistent residual over the whole 160-member field once per announced batch, so the only element taken is that a resampled refit is a legitimate source of that spread. It applies here because the session's accepted records are exactly the data the inherited GP is fitted to, so the resampling needs no new data, no model family change and no network.
adoptions.borrowed_element: That a model refitted on a bootstrap resample of the observed data can stand in for a draw from a posterior for the purpose of exploration, so the exploratory spread an allocation rule consumes need not come from a closed-form posterior quantity at all.

deviations.adopted_setting: Keep the inherited posterior mean and the inherited correlated sampled-maximum rule, and use eight resampled refits only to supply the marginal dispersion of that draw.
deviations.paper_setting: Act greedily on a single model fitted to one bootstrap resample, in a bandit or reinforcement-learning episode.
deviations.reason: Posterior-mean-only allocation is measured at -0.116317 and -0.126894 on this lineage and composite selector removal at -0.128183, so replacing the rule rather than the dispersion source would change several measured-positive consumers at once and would not be one attributable intervention.

deviations.adopted_setting: Resample only the session's own real accepted records; no artificial or prior pseudo-data is generated.
deviations.paper_setting: Combine observed data with artificially generated data to induce a prior, which the authors describe as critical to the exploration.
deviations.reason: The task-agnostic offline condition admits only this session's chronological accepted real observations and freshly generated de novo graphs, and an artificial-prior construction would be a second untested object inside the same intervention.

deviations.adopted_setting: Eight members, with the pool-mean dispersion rescaled to the inherited pool-mean predictive SD by a single constant per batch.
deviations.paper_setting: One resampled model per decision or per episode, with no constraint on the spread it implies.
deviations.reason: Round 46 already measured a magnitude change of this dispersion (-0.035153) on this Anchor, so the magnitude is held fixed by construction to keep the reading about the ordering; eight is a single bound value and authorizes no sweep.

adoptions.implementation_change: FingerprintPosterior.ensemble_dispersion refits the inherited accepted-only count-Morgan GP on eight full-size resamples with replacement of the session's own chronological accepted records, drawn from a dedicated generator, and select consumes the spread of those refits' pool predictive means as the per-candidate dispersion of the inherited correlated residual.

adoptions.applicability: The ensemble here is eight refits of one fixed-kernel Gaussian process on resampled accepted records, not eight neural networks, so only the disagreement-as-dispersion principle and the pointwise reading transfer. They apply because the inherited predictor is cheap enough to refit eight times per announced batch inside the frozen timeouts, measured at 0.056 s per batch in this plan's read-only replay.
adoptions.borrowed_element: That the disagreement among independently fitted members of an ensemble of the same model family is itself a usable per-input predictive uncertainty, read pointwise, rather than a closed-form function of the input, and that such disagreement tends to be larger on inputs unlike the training data.

deviations.adopted_setting: Eight refits of the inherited fixed-kernel count-Morgan GP on bootstrap resamples, with no hyperparameter fitting and no training objective of any kind.
deviations.paper_setting: An ensemble of independently initialized and trained deep networks, scored by a proper scoring rule and optionally with adversarial training.
deviations.reason: The inherited model fits no hyperparameters and has a closed-form conditioning path; keeping it byte-identical inside every member is what makes the dispersion source the only object that changes.

deviations.adopted_setting: Member diversity comes only from resampling the accepted records with replacement, which duplicates rows and leaves the refits correlated.
deviations.paper_setting: Member diversity comes from random initialization and data order over a full training set.
deviations.reason: A deterministic kernel conditioning has no initialization to vary, so resampling is the only available source of disagreement; the consequence that the raw disagreement can be small is handled by the declared rescaling and the 1e-12 pool-mean floor, and was measured at a median rescaling constant of 2.2304 in this plan's read-only replay.

deviations.adopted_setting: It is used only as the marginal scale of the inherited correlated allocation residual; the reported predictive mean and the cross-candidate correlation pattern remain the inherited posterior's.
deviations.paper_setting: The ensemble's uncertainty is used as the reported predictive uncertainty of the model.
deviations.reason: Every measured-positive consumer of the inherited posterior is preserved exactly, so the ensemble enters at one point only.

adoptions.implementation_change: The per-candidate dispersion is the divisor-eight root mean square of the eight member predictive means about their own ensemble mean, evaluated on the same 160 pool feature rows the inherited posterior uses, and is logged per member in the node's own pool receipt beside the inherited predictive SD.

literature_review.conclusion: This reuses the ticket's frozen bottleneck review r47-bottleneck-dispersion-source-not-price, whose searches and sources are carried unchanged, and re-reads the two sources it actually implements to fix the exact elements adopted. The literature supplies the direction and the shape of the construction and nothing more: that a bootstrap refit of the observed data can replace a posterior draw (1507.00300) and that disagreement among refits of one model family is a usable pointwise dispersion (1612.01474). It also bounds the expectation rather than supporting it - the molecular uncertainty comparison reports that no method it tested is unequivocally superior and that error ranking is unreliable across datasets (2005.10036), and the structured-space precedent is only that model-based optimizers routinely abandon a stationary-kernel GP's uncertainty (2109.09831), which this position deliberately does not do because keeping the inherited count-Morgan predictive mean is what makes the change one attributable intervention. The decision to test the dispersion's source rather than its price or its scale rests on internal evidence measured on this Anchor: its own predictive SD has a per-pool rank correlation of 0.9401 with nearest-neighbour archive distance over 420 published pools, the magnitude correction of that same statistic ran exactly and lost -0.035153, closed-form pricing lost -0.053288, explicit distance amplification lost -0.081702 while converting its far purchases at 0.000232 of mass per evaluation against 0.001752, and removing the term costs -0.126894. Literature origin is not permission to continue: one complete exposed panel plus its behavioural reading ends this construction. The same read-only replay that measured the bottleneck also shows the declared construction decouples the statistic (0.2600 mean rank correlation) while matching its pool-mean magnitude to 4.0e-16 and still buying slightly more sub-six-heavy-atom molecules on identical pools, so a decoupled dispersion that keeps buying degenerate candidates is a live outcome and is registered as such rather than predicted away.

sources.applicability: The Anchor already samples a jointly consistent residual across the whole 160-member pool once per announced batch; this source supplies the one element we take, that a bootstrap resample of the session own accepted records can play the role of the posterior draw, so the dispersion the rule reads stops being a kernel distance. We adopt neither their bandit or RL setting, their artificial-prior construction, nor any reported number.
sources.finding: Thompson-sampling exploration can be implemented without maintaining or sampling an explicit posterior: fit a model to a bootstrap resample of the observed data (optionally with artificially generated data that induces a prior) and act greedily on that one resampled model, which the authors argue is what makes the exploration coherent across a whole episode rather than independent per decision.
sources.title: Bootstrapped Thompson Sampling and Deep Exploration

sources.applicability: We adopt only the principle that disagreement among refits of the same model family on resampled data is a usable dispersion, and the practice of reading it per input. We adopt no neural architecture, no adversarial training, no proper-scoring-rule objective (the Anchor fits no hyperparameters) and none of their datasets or numbers.
sources.finding: An ensemble of independently trained predictors, scored by a proper scoring rule, yields predictive uncertainty that is competitive with or better than Bayesian alternatives such as MC dropout, and in particular expresses higher uncertainty on out-of-distribution inputs; the uncertainty is the ensemble disagreement rather than a closed-form function of the input.
sources.title: Simple and Scalable Predictive Uncertainty Estimation using Deep Ensembles

sources.applicability: This is the external statement of this lineage own measurement: the Anchor dispersion IS a Tanimoto-distance statistic, and round 46 showed that correcting its magnitude (n-707027cd2146) does not help because the ordering, not the scale, is what is wrong. It bounds our expectation too: an ensemble dispersion is not promised to be better calibrated, which is why this position registers a behavioural reading rather than a predicted gain.
sources.finding: In a systematic comparison on molecular regression the authors separate distance-based uncertainty estimates (Tanimoto distance in structure space, Euclidean distance in latent space) from ensemble, mean-variance and union-based estimates, and state explicitly that Tanimoto distance is a relative quantity and not a metric intended to match the magnitude of error, excluding the distance-based methods from their miscalibration and NLL analyses; no method is unequivocally superior, and ensembles tend to underestimate out-of-domain error.
sources.title: Uncertainty Quantification Using Neural Networks for Molecular Property Prediction

sources.applicability: Precedent that model-based optimization over structured spaces routinely replaces a stationary-kernel GP with a surrogate whose uncertainty is not a kernel distance. We take only the precedent and the direction, not a random forest, because keeping the inherited count-Morgan predictive mean is what makes this position one attributable change; the page we read does not state how its forest obtains variance and we claim nothing about that.
sources.finding: For conditional, high-dimensional and otherwise complex search spaces the package uses a random forest surrogate rather than a Gaussian process with a stationary kernel, and the authors attribute SMAC advantage in those spaces to that choice; the Gaussian-process facade is reserved for low-dimensional continuous problems.
sources.title: SMAC3: A Versatile Bayesian Optimization Package for Hyperparameter Optimization

hypothesis: Replace the source of the per-candidate dispersion that the inherited correlated Thompson allocation reads, holding its pool-mean magnitude fixed. At each announced batch, after the inherited posterior is fitted, eight bootstrap resamples with replacement at full size are drawn from the session's own chronological accepted records and the same accepted-only count-Morgan generalized-Tanimoto GP is refitted on each, with the inherited 0.05 observation-noise SD, the inherited adaptive mean and population-SD normalization with its 0.001 floor and the inherited float64 Cholesky jitter ladder. For each of the 160 pool members the ensemble dispersion sigma_ens(x) is the root mean square of the eight member predictive means about their own ensemble mean (divisor eight); it is rescaled by the single pool-level constant (pool mean of the inherited predictive SD) / (pool mean of sigma_ens) to give sigma_tilde, whose pool mean equals the inherited pool-mean predictive SD exactly. The allocator residual becomes diag(sigma_tilde) times the Cholesky factor of the inherited correlation matrix - the inherited pool covariance divided by its own marginal SDs - times the inherited standard-normal row, so the cross-candidate correlation pattern, the single (10, 160) array, its generator, its order and its consumption count are unchanged, and substituting the inherited predictive SD for sigma_tilde reproduces the Parent's own sampled function values. Fewer than twenty accepted records in the session, or a pool-mean sigma_ens below 1e-12, leaves the inherited residual expression in place and is reported. The predictive mean, the kernel and its vocabulary, the normalization, the noise SD, the jitter ladder, the sequentially masked sampled-maxima rule with its first-index tie, the stall-time eligibility mask with K=3 and M=40, pool_multiplier 16, admission, retention and breeding are exactly as inherited.

finding_summary.headline: Dispersion decoupled from archive distance exactly as designed; fragment buying halved, oversize buying rose sixfold, panel -0.0608
finding_summary.insights: The campaign's leading structural story survives this test, but in a weaker and more useful form. It held that predictive uncertainty under this count-Morgan covariance is a proxy for molecular degeneracy, so any rule that rewards uncertainty is arbitraged by degenerate molecules. This node removed the premise and kept the conclusion: the dispersion is now almost uncorrelated with archive distance (+0.23 against +0.94) and almost uncorrelated with molecular size (per-pool Spearman with heavy-atom count -0.001, where the inherited SD gives -0.213 and its top decile averages 16.5 heavy atoms against the new statistic's 30.3), and the budget still went to degenerate objects, only to the large end instead of the small one. The arbitrage is therefore not a property of the archive-distance statistic. It is a property of a search in which nothing prices molecular size or scaffold identity, so whichever end of the size axis a dispersion stops defending becomes the end that drifts. That rules out the whole 'better uncertainty statistic' family as a remedy for degeneracy on this lineage: archive-distance magnitude correction, closed-form pricing, explicit distance amplification, removal, and now a dispersion built from a different source entirely have all failed in the same direction, and none of them failed because the statistic's ordering was wrong. What the search actually did is visible in the trajectories and it is a local-refinement ratchet, not an exploration deficit. Purchases moved closer to the session archive than the inherited rule's would have on identical pools (mean nearest-neighbour distance 0.104 against 0.147), scaffold counts fell and within-batch similarity rose, and on deco_hop seed 0 the run grew one lineage of head-to-tail concatenated xanthine-like rings to a session median of 76.5 heavy atoms, 213 of 290 purchases above fifty and a maximum of 119, while its best score crept 0.588 to 0.605 and the cell lost 0.251 against the Anchor's compact 30-heavy-atom tricycle at 0.856. The score surface permits this: the molecular report finds a hard 0.5 floor on deco_hop and a flat top end, so mass is never punished, and the 187 proposals above seventy heavy atoms all score below the run's best, which is a 45-atom molecule. The cost is not only score: that one cell's oracle time rose from 84 to 4893 seconds, 68 per cent of the frozen task timeout, while the declared ensemble work itself cost 9.3 seconds across all fifteen sessions. The surrogate's ranking is not the limitation in general - predicted-versus-realized batch rank correlation is 0.496 against the Anchor's 0.515 with lower prediction error - but it is the limitation on the worst cell: sitagliptin_mpo is the weakest-ranked objective in both runs and fell further here (0.208 against 0.328), and it is the seed where the molecular report finds the generator hanging thiols and phenols on the scaffold instead of fluorinating it while the Anchor's same-seed run fluorinated 269 of 290 proposals and reached 0.766. That points the next move away from the dispersion and toward the predictive location, which no node on this Anchor has touched, and toward a proposal or batch-selection scheme that is explicit about scaffold identity and molecular size - a diversity-aware batch acquisition over scaffold-level features, or a surrogate whose features are size-normalised - rather than any further choice of uncertainty estimator. Two things this result cannot settle. The gated reading is unavailable: this Anchor has only its ungated law-free reference, the trigger-matched gated reference is the sibling ticket bound in the same batch and it has no realization yet, so the in-regime stratum here (exposure 109 of 435 batches in 15 of 15 sessions against the Anchor's 88 in 13 of 15; conversion 0.000306 against 0.000622 per evaluation) stays a descriptive control and supports no claim about the eligibility mask. And the attribution of the 0.911 drop in increment mass is bounded rather than clean: the panel loss is only 0.005 outside a band whose own half-width is seventeen times the registered effect size, 70.6 per cent of it sits in the two cells the rule pre-registered as fragile, and the newly-bought-versus-agreed conversion split is selection-conditioned accounting, because candidates nobody bought carry no scores. The configuration is closed either way: its own conditions forbid sweeping the resample count, the resampling design, the rescaling rule or the record threshold, and the behavioural reading that was supposed to justify continuation came back saying the statistic was never the binding object.
finding_summary.results: The construction ran in every announced batch of a complete fifteen-cell panel and did what it was built to do. The dispersion the allocator reads stopped being an archive-distance statistic: its per-pool rank correlation with nearest-neighbour archive distance is +0.2335 in the median session against the Anchor's own +0.9397 recomputed in the same audit (420 pools: mean +0.2317, median +0.2736, range -0.4482 to +0.8185, against the Anchor's mean +0.9401, median +0.9409, range +0.8526 to +0.9962), and not one of the 420 pools lands within 0.05 of the Anchor's value. The magnitude confound that sank the round-46 correction was removed by construction: the pool mean of the rescaled dispersion equals the inherited pool-mean predictive SD to a maximum relative error of 4.4e-16 over all 420 non-guard batches, with the realized rescaling constant ranging 0.67 to 12.43 (median 2.27). The guard fired in exactly the fifteen first batches, where fewer than twenty records exist, and those fifteen batches are byte-identical to the Anchor's in pool, posterior mean, predictive SD, drawn normals, sampled function values and all ten picks; there were no floor hits and no member refit failures in 420 ensembles. The new statistic routed real purchases. Against an in-node replay of the inherited predictive SD over the same drawn normals, the same correlation factor and the same eligible set, the ten purchases overlap 4.62 of 10 on average, never all ten in any of the 420 non-guard batches, and 2260 of 4350 evaluations are candidates the inherited statistic would not have bought. Purchases from the top decile of the dispersion actually read rose to 1291 of 4350 against the Anchor's 199, and those picks are no longer dead weight: they converted at 0.001833 of incumbent-increment mass per evaluation, where the Anchor's top-predictive-SD-decile picks converted at 0.000025. The posterior-mean rank profile stayed close to the Anchor's (926 of 3110 non-guard out-of-regime purchases at rank 40 or worse, 29.77 per cent, against 908 of 3320, 27.35 per cent; the matched in-node counterfactual on identical pools would have been 1011, 32.51 per cent), and in-regime it is 0 of 1090 by the retained eligibility bar, as designed. What the purchases bought is the result that matters. Degenerate small molecules fell as predicted: evaluations below six heavy atoms 91 to 64, and the top dispersion decile is 7.1 per cent sub-six-atom members against 30.8 per cent for the inherited SD on the same pools. But the other degenerate end took their place: evaluations above fifty heavy atoms rose 44 to 296, mean size 28.50 to 33.16, the top decile went from 2.9 to 10.6 per cent oversize, distinct Murcko scaffolds per session fell 117.5 to 95.1 and fragment-excluded within-batch similarity rose 0.311 to 0.325. Realized incumbent-increment mass fell 5.978073 to 5.066743 over the same 4350-evaluation denominator, and the split is informative: the purchases the new statistic uniquely routed converted at 0.000482 per evaluation against 0.001904 for the purchases both statistics agreed on. The endpoint is a loss. The complete paired panel is 0.546275 against the Anchor's 0.607030, delta -0.060755 (seeds -0.141024 / -0.010163 / -0.031079), against a registered non-inferiority margin of +0.002, and it sits 0.005273 below the lower edge of this Anchor's own law-free band [-0.055482, +0.014579]. Three of fifteen cells are positive. Two of the four protected task means breach their margins (deco_hop -0.091415 and sitagliptin_mpo -0.158841 against 0.02 each), drd2_docking -0.024418 holds inside its 0.03 and zaleplon_mpo -0.017554 inside its 0.02 with 0.002446 of headroom; median_2 -0.011549 stays inside its registered band. The two cells the reading rule registered as fragile, deco_hop seed 0 and sitagliptin_mpo seed 0, carry 70.6 per cent of the cell-delta sum; they are reported and not excluded, and the remaining thirteen cells average -0.020631, which is almost exactly the law-free re-draw's own -0.020452.

The cost is not only score: that one cell's oracle time rose from 84 to 4893 seconds, 68 per cent of the frozen task timeout, while the declared ensemble work itself cost 9.3 seconds across all fifteen sessions. The surrogate's ranking is not the limitation in general - predicted-versus-realized batch rank correlation is 0.496 against the Anchor's 0.515 with lower prediction error - but it is the limitation on the worst cell: sitagliptin_mpo is the weakest-ranked objective in both runs and fell further here (0.208 against 0.328), and it is the seed where the molecular report finds the generator hanging thiols and phenols on the scaffold instead of fluorinating it while the Anchor's same-seed run fluorinated 269 of 290 proposals and reached 0.766. That points the next move away from the dispersion and toward the predictive location, which no node on this Anchor has touched, and toward a proposal or batch-selection scheme that is explicit about scaffold identity and molecular size - a diversity-aware batch acquisition over scaffold-level features, or a surrogate whose features are size-normalised - rather than any further choice of uncertainty estimator. Two things this result cannot settle. The gated reading is unavailable: this Anchor has only its ungated law-free reference, the trigger-matched gated reference is the sibling ticket bound in the same batch and it has no realization yet, so the in-regime stratum here (exposure 109 of 435 batches in 15 of 15 sessions against the Anchor's 88 in 13 of 15; conversion 0.000306 against 0.000622 per evaluation) stays a descriptive control and supports no claim about the eligibility mask. And the attribution of the 0.911 drop in increment mass is bounded rather than clean: the panel loss is only 0.005 outside a band whose own half-width is seventeen times the registered effect size, 70.6 per cent of it sits in the two cells the rule pre-registered as fragile, and the newly-bought-versus-agreed conversion split is selection-conditioned accounting, because candidates nobody bought carry no scores. The configuration is closed either way: its own conditions forbid sweeping the resample count, the resampling design, the rescaling rule or the record threshold, and the behavioural reading that was supposed to justify continuation came back saying the statistic was never the binding object.

molecular.headline: Pool-derived fused heteroaromatics decorated with single halogens on N and O; one run inflated to 70-119 heavy atoms and gained no score.
molecular.overall_character: Across all five objectives the generator emits small-to-mid fused heteroaromatics that are recognisably decorated descendants of the ten starting-pool molecules. Ring and aromatic content is high everywhere (digest ring_closure_rate 0.932-1.000, aromatic_atom_rate 0.914-1.000) and string-level uniqueness is near total (856-880 unique of 870 proposals per objective), but the move set is almost entirely peripheral: single atom swaps, single halogen appends, alkyl lengthening and ring-size perturbation. Two consequences dominate the chemistry. First, halogens and extra oxygens are attached to heteroatoms as readily as to carbon, so 522 of the 4350 optimizer proposals contain an N-F/N-Cl/N-Br bond, 273 contain an O-F bond and 313 contain an O-O bond (181 of those an O-O-O chain) - and the single highest-scoring molecule on three of five objectives contains one of these unmakeable bonds. Meanwhile 0 of 4350 proposals carry a CF3 group, a formal charge or a stereodescriptor. Second, size is unregulated in both directions: on deco_hop the proposal median climbed from 31 to 84 heavy atoms inside one seed (max 119) while the best score moved 0.588 to 0.598, and elsewhere the delete operator bottoms out at fragments such as CC, CCO, N and CCCCC that sit on the objective floor. The molecules the optimizer actually selects are therefore chemically narrow and often not isolable compounds, even where the score is high.

per_task.generated_character: The tightest-banded set after sitagliptin_mpo: 870 optimizer proposals, median 24 heavy atoms (max 42, mean SMILES length 43.5), median 3 ring-closure pairs, every molecule aromatic and ring-bearing (digest aromatic_atom_rate 1.00, ring_closure_rate 1.00) and 89.4% halogen-bearing. Essentially the whole run is one scaffold: the 5,6-dimethoxyindole-2-carboxanilide handed in by the starting pool at evaluation 9 (COc1cc2[nH]c(C(=O)Nc3ccc(F)cc3)cc2c(OC)c1OC, 0.305), re-decorated into a 4,6-dialkyl-5-methoxyindole-2-carboxamide whose indole nitrogen carries a halogen and whose anilide has become a pyridin-3-yl amide. 156 of 870 proposals contain a nitrogen-halogen bond and 137 a ring thiocarbonyl. No charges, no stereocentres, only 4 proposals at 12 or fewer heavy atoms.
liabilities: the four joint-best molecules all carry an N-halogenated indole (n2Br, n2Cl, n2F); an N-bromoindole is not an isolable compound
N-fluoro amide in the fifth-best molecule CCc1c(OC)cc2c(cc(C(=O)N(F)c3ccc(F)nc3)n2Br)c1C (0.4344)
N-bromo amide plus N-chloroamine in C=Cc1c(N(C)Cl)cc2[nH]c(C(=O)NBr)cc2c1C, still being proposed at evaluation 297
137 of 870 proposals install a thiocarbonyl on the heteroaromatic core
early proposals are 41-42 heavy-atom head-to-tail bis-indole amides that score at machine zero, e.g. COc1cc2[nH]c(C(=O)NOc3c(OC)cc4[nH]c(C(=O)Nc5ccc(Cl)cc5)cc4c3OC)cc2c(OC)c1OC
missing_features: no flexible aliphatic amide or N-alkyl acetamide side chain anywhere; all 870 proposals keep the aryl amide inherited from the starting pool
only 1 of 870 proposals carries a nitrile, so polar neutral substituents that add no hydrogen-bond donor are essentially unexplored
no nitrogen-rich fused 5-6 bicycle other than the inherited indole (median 3 and maximum 5 ring-closure pairs)
no stereodescriptor and no formal charge in any proposal
per_task.score_gradient_reading: Three edits carry all of the gain over the 0.305 seed molecule: swapping the aniline for a pyridin-3-yl amide (CCc1c(C)cc2c(cc(C(=O)Nc3cccnc3)n2Cl)c1C, 0.4220), restoring a 5-methoxy in place of 5-methyl (0.4388 vs 0.4285 for the otherwise identical methyl analogue) and alkylating the benzo ring. Past that the gradient is flat in halogen identity - n2Br, n2Cl and n2F variants and 4-F versus 4-Br on the pyridine all return exactly 0.4387992465191, and the top 50 proposals contain only 14 distinct scores. Losing the bicycle is catastrophic (Fc1ccc(F)cc1, 2.2e-13). The run reached 0.4388 at evaluation 219 and never left that scaffold; its ceiling is set by the scaffold it inherited, not by the decoration it is permuting.

per_task.generated_character: The size outlier of the five. 870 proposals with median 41 heavy atoms against 24-34 everywhere else, mean 48.1, maximum 119; mean SMILES length 88.6 and maximum 253. 255 of 870 proposals exceed 50 heavy atoms and 187 exceed 70. Ring density is extreme (ring_closure_rate 0.977, up to 21 ring-closure pairs in one molecule) and halogen content the second lowest (0.464). The three seeds produced three different chemistries: seed 1 converged on a ~45 heavy-atom biphenyl-linked bis(oxazolo-fused pyrimidinone) bearing OCF and thiomethyl groups (CCOc1nc(OCOCF)nc(-c2ccccc2-c2nc(=O)oc3nc(OCF)c(CSC)c(OC)c23)nc(=O)oc(C)n1, 0.6280); seed 0 grew head-to-tail concatenations of four to eight xanthine-like pyrimidinedione/thione rings, each N-arylated by a pyridine, up to 119 heavy atoms; seed 2 locked onto a benzofuran-3-carboxamide decorated with peroxide and trioxide ethers - 262 of its 290 proposals contain an O-O bond and 180 contain O-O-O.
liabilities: 272 of 870 proposals contain an O-O bond and 180 an O-O-O chain; the seed-2 final molecules are built on them, e.g. COOCc1c(OOC)c(C(N=O)Nc2ccc(OOOC)cn2)c2occc2c1OOC at 0.612
C-nitroso amidine (C(N=O)N) throughout the seed-2 endgame, e.g. CCOOc1cnc(NC(N=O)c2c(OCC)c(OOC)c(CC)c3ccoc23)nn1
119 heavy-atom oligomers that no chemist would make and no screening deck would accept, scoring 0.593
cumulated double bonds in 7.4% of proposals (digest cumulated_double_bond_rate 0.0736), including allene/ketenimine fragments at the head of the largest molecules
301 of 870 proposals install a ring thiocarbonyl, and the best molecules carry OCF monofluoromethyl ethers
missing_features: no compact single fused tricycle in the 28-32 heavy-atom range among the top molecules - the best is 45 heavy atoms and the median proposal 41
no single rotatable hinge such as an amide, sulfonamide or ether connecting two small ring systems; the linkers that appear are direct ring-ring bonds, biphenyls and shared ring edges
nitriles appear in only 76 of 870 proposals here, so a small strongly polar terminal group is largely untested on this core
0 of 870 proposals contain an aliphatic N-(C)n-N ring fragment, so no saturated nitrogen heterocycle was ever offered
no stereodescriptors and no formal charges in any proposal
per_task.score_gradient_reading: There is a hard observable floor at 0.5: CC, CCO, COOC and CCCl all score exactly 0.5, so the 23 proposals at 12 or fewer heavy atoms bought no information at all. Above the floor everything is compressed into 0.5-0.628 and the top 50 span only 0.6252-0.6280 across 14 distinct values. The decisive reading is that size did not pay: the 187 proposals above 70 heavy atoms have median score 0.596 and maximum 0.611, every one below the run's best 0.628, which is a 45 heavy-atom molecule. In seed 0 the proposal median rose from 31 heavy atoms (evaluations 1-50) to 83.5-84.5 (evaluations 101-200) and stayed near 73 to the end while its best score crept 0.588 to 0.605; the Parent's seed 0, whose proposal median stayed at 27-30 heavy atoms, reached 0.856 in its final fifty evaluations on a 30 heavy-atom tricycle (O=c1c2c3n(-c4ncnc5cc(OF)c(Cl)cc45)nc2n(c(=S)n1C(F)OCCl)C3). The gradient here rewards one compact fused heteroaromatic core with a single aryl hinge; this node answered it with mass.

per_task.generated_character: 870 proposals, all 870 unique, median 32 heavy atoms, 99.0% aromatic, 99.9% ring-bearing and the most halogenated set of the five (99.5%). Unusually, size shrank over the run: median 39 heavy atoms in the first hundred evaluations and 31 after evaluation 200, with only 18 proposals above 50 heavy atoms. Two families own the top end - a 3-chloro-5-methoxy-toluene biaryl whose benzylic carbon carries an N-methyl-1,4-diazepane (COc1cc(Cl)cc(-c2ccc(C(Br)C3CN(C)CCCCN3)cc2Cl)c1C, 0.9816) and a benzoxazine/chromane fused to a tetrahydroisoquinolinone through a vinyl fluoride (CCN1CC(CN)Oc2cc(Cl)ccc2C1C(=CF)C1CCCc2ccc(F)cc2C(=O)N1, 0.9815). 329 of 870 proposals carry an aliphatic ring diamine. The bottom end is the starting pool's 3,5-dichlorobenzenesulfonyl prolinamide, essentially untouched.
liabilities: the single best molecule carries a benzylic bromide (C(Br) between two aryl systems), a potent alkylating agent rather than a candidate
N-chloro amide in the lowest-scoring molecule O=C(NCl)C1CCCN1S(=O)(=O)c1cc(Cl)cc(Cl)c1
cyclic sulfinamide S(=O)N in the 0.9815 family and in 192 of 870 proposals; sulfinamides are configurationally labile and readily oxidised
vinyl fluoride C(=CF) as a core linker in the seed-2 top family, including the final proposal CNCN1CC(CN)Oc2cc(Cl)ccc2C1C(=CF)C1CCCc2ccc(F)cc2S(=O)N1
aminal and N-aminomethyl groups (CN(CN), CNCN) in the endgame molecules; 151 of 870 proposals also carry a thiocarbonyl
an 83 heavy-atom two-pool-molecule concatenation proposed at evaluation 38 for a score of 0.0289
missing_features: no formally charged or protonated amine: 0 of 870 proposals carry a formal charge although the basic ring nitrogen is exactly what the gradient rewards
no stereochemistry: the 0.98-scoring molecules each carry two to four undefined sp3 stereocentres and no proposal in the run bears a stereodescriptor
no aryl-piperazine: only 9 of 870 proposals contain an N-C-C-N fragment, and the basic diamines that do appear were reached by ring expansion of a pool piperidine
no aromatic heterocycle substituted for the chlorobenzene among the top molecules - the high-scoring aryl rings are all carbocyclic
no simple aliphatic linker variation: the amine is attached through one or two carbons in every top molecule
per_task.score_gradient_reading: This is the best-resolved gradient in the node: run median 0.516, top 50 spanning 0.944-0.982 across 39 distinct values. What separates 0.98 from 1.7e-4 is visible in the molecules without any task knowledge - every high scorer places a secondary or tertiary aliphatic amine inside a six- or seven-membered ring, one or two atoms from a chlorinated aromatic, and has shed the arylsulfonamide; every bottom scorer retains the sulfonyl-proline amide and has no basic nitrogen at all (O=C(NCl)C1CCCN1S(=O)(=O)c1cc(Cl)cc(Cl)c1, 1.7e-4). Size is punished absolutely: the single proposal above 70 heavy atoms, an 83 heavy-atom dimer of two pool molecules, scored 0.0289. The generator did find the right pharmacophore class here - it just reached it decorated with alkylating and oxidisable groups, and its best (0.9816) stayed below the Parent's 1.0000.

per_task.generated_character: The most ring-dense and least decorated set: 870 proposals, median 34 heavy atoms, median 5 ring-closure pairs, but the lowest halogen content of the five (digest halogen_rate 0.1851, only 23 of 870 with an aromatic fluorine) and the lowest aromatic fraction (0.9138), reflecting a lot of sp3 ring-fusion carbon. The dominant chemistry is a hybrid polycycle: a 2-propyl-4-ethoxyphenyl or 2-propylquinoline head bonded directly to a pyrazolo-fused hexahydropyrimidine-2,4-dione, best at CCCc1ccc(OCC)c(-c2c3c(nn2-c2ccccc2C)CN(C)C(=O)N(C)C(=O)C3)c1 (0.2308). 145 of 870 proposals carry an aliphatic ring diamine. The set is bracketed by 67 proposals at 12 or fewer heavy atoms - including N, C=C, NCCCS and seed 2's very last proposal CCCCC (0.0235) - and a tail of four pentacyclic 70-79 heavy-atom dimers scoring 0.115-0.127.
liabilities: 67 of 870 proposals (7.7% of the oracle budget on this objective) are 12 heavy atoms or fewer, including N, C=C and NCCCS, all scoring exactly 0.0

mixed anhydride in the 70-79 heavy-atom pentacyclic dimers, e.g. CCOC(=O)C1CCN(C)CC1n1c(=O)n(C)c(=O)c2c1cn1c3c(O)ccc(C(=O)OC(=O)c4ccc(O)c5c4c4ccccc4c4c6c(=O)n(C)c(=O)n(C7CN(C)CNC7C(=O)OCC)c6cn54)c3c3ccccc3c21 at 0.1146
N-hydroxy imide variants inside the top twelve, e.g. CCCc1ccc(OCC)c(-c2c3c(nn2-c2ccccc2C)CN(O)C(=O)N(C)C(=O)C3)c1 at 0.2242
32 of 870 proposals contain an O-F bond and a further 14 an O-O bond (one of them an O-O-O chain)
thiol and thioether substituents appended directly to the aminal-bearing ring in the seed-2 endgame, e.g. CCCc1c2c3c(n1-c1cc(OSC)nc4ccccc14)NCCC3C(C)C(=O)N(C)CC(=O)C2S
missing_features: no molecule in the run offers a single compact ring system with one decorated side chain; the top twelve all carry four or five fused or directly bonded rings
no non-fused linkage between the two ring halves - every top molecule joins them by a direct ring-ring bond or a shared edge, so a flexible two or three atom linker was never tested
almost no acidic or ionisable group to place polarity independently of the imide: 19 of 870 proposals carry a carboxylic acid, 0 carry a formal charge
no stereodescriptors despite three to four sp3 ring-fusion stereocentres in every top-scoring molecule
no halogenated analogue of the winning motif was explored in depth - only 161 of 870 proposals carry any halogen at all
per_task.score_gradient_reading: Everything lives in 0.0-0.2308 with run median 0.1766, so the oracle discriminates (top 50 spans 0.209-0.231 across 46 distinct values) but weakly, and the whole hybrid family sits inside 0.17-0.23. Within it, score tracks the alkyl length on the ether head (propyl 0.2308 above butyl 0.2230), N-methylation of both imide nitrogens, and keeping the pyrazole N-aryl group; it falls when either half of the hybrid is removed, and goes to exactly 0.0 for any fragment. No family in the run breaks the 0.231 plateau on any seed, and fusing the two ring systems ever more tightly - the seed-2 endgame is a pentacyclic bridged version of the same motif - did not help.

per_task.generated_character: The narrowest size band of the five: 870 proposals, median 27 heavy atoms, maximum 37, mean SMILES length 51.1 and maximum 68; 99.9% aromatic, 99.9% ring-bearing, 68.2% halogen-bearing, median 4 ring-closure pairs. One scaffold family runs the whole objective - a 1,3-dimethyl xanthine-like pyrazolo-pyrimidine-2,6-dione (or its pyrrolo isomer) carrying an N-aryl azole or pyridinol and a fluorinated cyclopentene, decorated with single fluorines placed indiscriminately on carbon, nitrogen and oxygen: best Cn1c(=O)c2c(C3=CCC(F)C3)n(-c3cn(F)c(F)c3COF)nc2n(C)c1=O at 0.6233. 337 of 870 proposals contain an N-halogen bond, 194 an O-F bond and 257 a terminal thiol. Non-amide nitrogen is nearly absent (59 of 870) and only 15 proposals carry a terminal NH2.
liabilities: an O-F hypofluorite in the single best molecule (the COF group of Cn1c(=O)c2c(C3=CCC(F)C3)n(-c3cn(F)c(F)c3COF)nc2n(C)c1=O) and in 194 of 870 proposals
N-fluoro azoles and N-fluoro imides in 337 of 870 proposals, including the best molecule's n(F) ring nitrogen
an S-F bond in CC1c2c(CF)nc(F)c(O)c2-n2cc3c(c21)c(=O)n(CCF)c(=O)n3CSF, proposed at evaluation 297 of seed 2 for 0.147
aromatic dithiols such as Oc1c(S)cc(CF)cc1S (3.2e-11) and the thiol-decorated seed-0 plateau molecules
monofluoromethyl ethers and fluoromethyl amines (COF, CF on ring nitrogen) throughout the top twelve; none of these survive aqueous handling
missing_features: no trifluoromethyl and effectively no geminal difluoride: 0 of 870 proposals carry CF3 and 1 carries a CF2, although 506 carry at least one fluorine and score tracks fluorine count
no primary aliphatic amine on an sp3 chain: 15 of 870 proposals end in NH2 and 1 carries a CH2NH2, and only 59 of 870 contain any non-amide nitrogen
no saturated nitrogen heterocycle: 1 of 870 proposals contains an aliphatic N-(C)n-N ring fragment
almost no explicit C(=O) group outside the aromatic imide (54 of 870 proposals), so an exocyclic amide or ketone linker was never tested
no stereodescriptors even though every top molecule carries a stereogenic fluorinated ring carbon
per_task.score_gradient_reading: The gradient tracks fluorine density, and the three seeds demonstrate it by diverging. Seeds 1 and 2 fluorinated the core heavily and reached 0.6233 and 0.5567; seed 0 instead hung aryl thiols and phenols on the same scaffold - 252 of its 290 proposals carry a terminal SH while only 57 carry any fluorine - and stalled at 0.3738 with O=c1c2c(C3C=CC3)n(-c3cc(S)ccc3O)nc2n(F)c(=O)n1CCS. The Parent's seed 0, whose 290 proposals contained fluorine 269 times, reached 0.7659 on the same scaffold class. Within the fluorinated family score rises with the count of C-F and CH2F groups and appears indifferent to where the fluorine sits, which is why the generator satisfied it with N-F and O-F bonds instead of carbon fluorination. Molecules below 10 heavy atoms (CCOOC, FCOc1ccccc1) sit at 1e-15 to 1e-14.

transferable_gaps.evidence: Across all 4350 optimizer proposals, 0 contain a trifluoromethyl group and 1 contains a geminal difluoromethylene, although 2139 contain at least one fluorine and on one objective the top-scoring molecules carry four or five separate single C-F or CH2F groups and score rises with their count. Fluorine is always added one atom at a time and always to a different heavy atom.
transferable_gaps.gap: The generator cannot put more than one halogen on the same carbon, so polyhalogenated carbon groups are outside its reachable set.
transferable_gaps.generator_implication: Multiple substitution on one carbon should be a single proposal move - substitute a hydrogen set on a chosen carbon, or draw the substituent from a small group vocabulary (CF3, CHF2, ring CF2) - rather than requiring several independent single-atom edits that each have to be accepted on their own score.

transferable_gaps.evidence: 522 of 4350 proposals contain an N-F, N-Cl or N-Br bond and 273 contain an O-F bond, reaching 337 and 194 of 870 on a single objective. The single highest-scoring molecule on three of the five objectives carries one of these bonds: an N-bromo indole at 0.4388, a C-O-F methyl hypofluorite plus an N-F azole at 0.6233, and a monofluoromethyl ether at 0.6280. One proposal also carries an S-F bond.
transferable_gaps.gap: Halogens are attached to nitrogen and oxygen as readily as to carbon, so the generator's own optima are often compounds that cannot be isolated.
transferable_gaps.generator_implication: The attachment-point choice has to be typed: a halogen substitution should be restricted to carbon, or a bond-type filter should reject heteroatom-halogen bonds before an oracle call is spent, so the budget is not spent discovering optima that are not compounds.

transferable_gaps.evidence: 313 of 4350 proposals contain an O-O bond and 181 contain an O-O-O chain. On one objective's seed-2 run, 262 of 290 proposals carry a peroxide and 180 carry a trioxide; the lock-in is total after evaluation 150, where 49 or 50 of every 50 consecutive proposals carry one, and the run's final molecules are built on them (COOCc1c(OOC)c(C(N=O)Nc2ccc(OOOC)cn2)c2occc2c1OOC at 0.612). The same seed also produced C-nitroso amidines.
transferable_gaps.gap: Atom insertion extends heteroatom runs without limit, producing peroxide and trioxide chains that a lineage can then sit on for the rest of its run.
transferable_gaps.generator_implication: Insertion should be constrained by the identity of the atoms it sits between - a newly inserted heteroatom must not be placed adjacent to another heteroatom - and a lineage carrying a motif no chemist would accept needs some route back out, since the score surface on its own never removed it.

transferable_gaps.evidence: On one objective the proposal median rose from 31 heavy atoms (evaluations 1-50) to 83.5 and 84.5 (evaluations 101-200) inside one seed and stayed near 73 to the end, with a maximum of 119; 187 of 870 proposals exceeded 70 heavy atoms, their median score was 0.596 and their maximum 0.611, while the run's best molecule, at 45 heavy atoms, scored 0.628. The code Parent's matching seed held a median of 27-30 heavy atoms over the same window and finished 0.25 higher. Elsewhere the single proposal above 70 heavy atoms scored 0.0289.
transferable_gaps.gap: Molecule size is unregulated upward: the proposal distribution drifts to masses far above where its own best molecules sit, and the oracle budget follows it.
transferable_gaps.generator_implication: Accepting a growth edit should be conditioned on a size prior - a heavy-atom cap relative to the molecule being edited, or a mass penalty applied to the acceptance decision rather than to the score - so that a scoring function that is flat in molecular weight cannot buy unbounded growth with the oracle budget.

transferable_gaps.evidence: 67 proposals on one objective and 23 on another were 12 heavy atoms or fewer, including CC, CCO, COOC, CCCl, N, C=C, NCCCS and CCCCC, with the last proposal of one whole seed being CCCCC. Each of these returned its objective's floor value exactly (0.5 and 0.0 respectively), and several appeared after evaluation 270, when the elite was already 30-45 heavy atoms.
transferable_gaps.gap: The deletion operator can shrink a molecule down to a fragment the scoring function cannot distinguish, and it does so repeatedly late in a run.
transferable_gaps.generator_implication: A minimum-size guard on proposals, or re-drawing the edit from the current elite when a deletion falls below that size, would return those evaluations to the search; a proposal that can only return the floor value is a wasted oracle call regardless of the objective.

transferable_gaps.evidence: 0 of 4350 proposals carry a stereodescriptor or a double-bond geometry marker; the digest reports stereocentre_rate 0.0 on all five objectives. Yet the highest-scoring molecules carry two to four undefined sp3 stereocentres each - CCN1CC(CN)Oc2cc(Cl)ccc2C1C(=CF)C1CCCc2ccc(F)cc2C(=O)N1 at 0.9815 has four, and the top molecules on two other objectives each have a stereogenic fluorinated or ring-fusion carbon.
transferable_gaps.gap: The generator emits no stereochemistry at all, so enantiomer and diastereomer choice is never a search move.
transferable_gaps.generator_implication: The representation should admit and mutate stereodescriptors, so that configuration at an existing centre is a proposal the optimizer can make and the score can discriminate, instead of being silently left unspecified on every molecule the method reports.

transferable_gaps.evidence: An aliphatic N-(C)n-N ring fragment appears in 329 of 870 and 145 of 870 proposals on two objectives - and the top molecule on one of them, COc1cc(Cl)cc(-c2ccc(C(Br)C3CN(C)CCCCN3)cc2Cl)c1C at 0.9816, carries one, as does every other molecule in its top twelve - but in 0 of 870, 1 of 870 and 8 of 870 proposals on the other three. Only 9 of the 870 proposals on the objective where this motif matters most contain an N-C-C-N fragment, and 0 of 4350 proposals anywhere carry a formal charge.
transferable_gaps.gap: Basic amine centres on ring systems appear only where the starting population already supplies one; the generator does not install them, and never emits a charged species.
transferable_gaps.generator_implication: Insertion of a saturated nitrogen heterocycle, and of a protonatable centre generally, should be an available ring-level move that does not depend on the initial population containing one; and the representation should allow a charged or protonated form, since a neutral SMILES is the only species the method can currently express.

transferable_gaps.evidence: On four of the five objectives the best molecule's ring skeleton is a decorated form of a molecule proposed in the first ten evaluations: the indole-2-carboxamide COc1cc2[nH]c(C(=O)Nc3ccc(F)cc3)cc2c(OC)c1OC, seeded at evaluation 9 for 0.305, is still the skeleton of the best molecule at evaluation 219, and the pyrimidinedione of CCOC(=O)c1ccc(O)c(-n2cc3c(c2-c2ccccc2)c(=O)n(C)c(=O)n3C)c1, seeded at evaluation 7, is the core of the top twelve on two further objectives. The largest proposals are head-to-tail concatenations of four to eight copies of one pool ring system. The top twelve on one objective differ only in halogen and alkyl identity, four of them returning exactly the same score, and the top 50 hold only 14 distinct scores on two objectives.
transferable_gaps.gap: Ring systems come from the starting population and are decorated or concatenated rather than replaced, so no run explores a genuinely different core.
transferable_gaps.generator_implication: The move set needs a ring replacement that swaps one whole ring for a different ring of comparable size from a scaffold vocabulary, so that the reachable set is not the decoration neighbourhood of the initial population; without it, a flat decoration gradient reads as convergence when it is actually an exhausted scaffold.

method_name: Mol GA: rank-selected de novo graph evolution
method_thesis: Anchor the root in Mol GA: maintain a population of oracle-evaluated molecular graphs, sample breeding parents across high-ranked quantiles, generate new offspring through graph crossover and atom/bond mutations, and update survivors greedily after each observation. These are the proposal and selection mechanisms described by [Tripp and Hernández-Lobato (2023)](https://arxiv.org/html/2310.09267v1). Start from the supplied initial observations and incorporate newly evaluated offspring immediately, following the evaluator's announced batching. Repeated graph edits and recombination create an evolving search space; no corpus ranking, stored molecule library, pretrained model, or fixed candidate enumeration is needed. The causal hypothesis is that direct selection on task-local scores concentrates successive structural changes around improving molecules quickly enough to raise the final best observed score. The published evidence concerns a larger-budget AUC-Top-10 setting, so its transfer to this benchmark's final Top-1 objective remains a hypothesis.
